+# SM86 agentic kernel campaign: Muse Glimmer
+
+Date: 2026-08-21. Host `AIS-1-2950X-L02`, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090, compute capability
+8.6, driver 610.57.04, Release `sm_86` image, CUDA 13.3.73. The campaign runs in the
+isolated `perf/agentic-kernels` worktree; the primary checkout remains untouched.
+
+The frozen route is `muse-glimmer-30b/groupwise-int`, DFlash2 draft width 4, INT8-G64
+Main KV, a fixed 131,072-token capacity, and the artifact
+`/mnt/nas/AltaStratusAI/models/Muse-Glimmer-30B-NInfer/muse_glimmer_30b.ninfer`
+(18,047,450,368 bytes). Program and Engine measurements use
+`CUDA_MODULE_LOADING=EAGER`. The campaign control is at most 24 candidates per cycle;
+the first fully qualified candidate starts a fresh cycle, and one complete 24-candidate
+no-win cycle stops Muse. Acceptance requires two independent real-round repetitions,
+each at least 2% faster than the fresh baseline, plus the public Op, unaffected-point,
+independent-oracle, Engine-sentinel, and registered-real-test gates.
+
+## Accepted cycles
+
+Cycle 1 accepted `b629605712756f073836370396150acf7c36acfd`, which enables the
+maintained BF16 grouped-dynamic-convolution projection MMA path on CC86. Its independent
+oracle, public boundary, Program, unaffected controls, Engine sentinels, and registered
+real test passed before cycle 2 began.
+
+Cycle 2 accepted `dc688b12dfe8edf8c1ed50062f95b59fd648e262`. It admits the already
+qualified SM8x Muse Q4 schedules on CC86 without modifying the generic Q4 fallback:
+`R64C40K128` for `[19968,6656],T=40`, `R32C40/BK128` for the other Muse
+geometries at `T=33..40`, and `R32C48/BK64` for those geometries at `T=41..48`.
+
+The decision-quality public Linear comparison used detached accepted-baseline and
+candidate binaries and symmetric ABBA/BAAB ordering at every one of the 162
+shape-by-extent points (nine registered Muse shapes, `T=32..49`). Every affected point
+improved. Summed latency across the nine shapes improved by 16.2% at `T=33`, 20.2% at
+`T=40`, and 10.3% at `T=41`; the remaining affected aggregate points lie between 10.2%
+and 16.4%. The unchanged `T=32` and `T=49` aggregate controls changed by +0.04% and
+-0.00%. On `[19968,6656]`, only the intended `T=40` point changed (-15.3%); its
+neighboring generic points were neutral. The smallest affected pointwise win was 1.39%.
+
+Paired Muse Program results at 8,192 resident tokens per request, draft width 4, five
+warmups, and 31 measured rounds were:
+
+| Concurrency | Baseline GPU ms | Candidate GPU ms | Change | Baseline tok/s | Candidate tok/s |
+|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
+| C1 | 91.0738 | 91.0814 | +0.01% | 46.3968 | 46.3928 |
+| C4 | 104.922 | 104.849 | -0.07% | 161.093 | 161.205 |
+| C8 pair 1 | 117.377 | 107.822 | -8.14% | 288.000 | 313.522 |
+| C8 pair 2 | 117.535 | 107.947 | -8.16% | 287.612 | 313.156 |
+
+Every pair retained identical drafted tokens, accepted tokens, per-position acceptance,
+and licensed-token counts. C1 (`T=5`) and C4 (`T=20`) therefore remain neutral while the
+changed C8 (`T=40`) boundary clears the real-round gate twice.
+
+## Correctness and semantic gates
+
+The public `ginfer_linear_q4_a16_test` passed against its independent FP64 oracle across
+the registered geometry and route seams. The maintained
+`ginfer_muse_glimmer_30b_real_test` passed under EAGER module loading, covering real
+artifact residency, DFlash execution, wrapped cyclic-prefix behavior, and exact-capacity
+generation.
+
+The public Engine retrieval sentinels both returned exactly
+`ORCHID=493817; COLOR=COBALT`:
+
+| Fixture | Prompt tokens | Prefill tok/s | Generated tokens | Decode tok/s | DFlash acceptance |
+|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
+| 8K | 7,641 | 1,070.04 | 182 | 41.33 | 69.79% |
+| 128K | 129,041 | 731.95 | 494 | 38.33 | 72.24% |
+
+The Engine rows are semantic sentinels with stochastic sampling, not paired kernel
+performance claims. The maintained Program round supplies the paired acceptance result.
+
+## Evidence and current status
+
+Raw Server 2 evidence remains ignored under:
+
+- `profiles/sm86/rtx3090/muse-glimmer-cycle2/baseline-b6296057/`;
+- `profiles/sm86/rtx3090/muse-glimmer-cycle2/candidate1-dc688b12/paired-c8/`;
+- `profiles/sm86/rtx3090/muse-glimmer-cycle2/candidate1-dc688b12/paired-controls/`;
+- `profiles/sm86/rtx3090/muse-glimmer-cycle2/candidate1-dc688b12/paired-linear-pointwise/`;
+- `profiles/sm86/rtx3090/muse-glimmer-cycle2/candidate1-dc688b12/semantic/`.
+
+Continuous telemetry records timestamp, temperature, GPU utilization, SM and memory
+clocks, power, and resident memory. Public Linear CSV files retain the semantic one-read
+effective-GB/s model and the RTX 3090 DRAM-reference percentages. Nsight reports remain
+diagnostic evidence and are not committed.
+
+Muse optimization is still active. Cycle 3 starts from the accepted cycle-2 source and
+will obtain a fresh C1/C8 profile before its first candidate. No SM89 or SM120a runtime
+claim is made by these SM86 results.
